weapons.name: ПМ
weapons.description: compact blued-steel PM pistol with brown grip
weapons.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: pixel-art animation source sheet for a 2D survival videogame. Reference image is the approved appearance of ПМ, a compact blued-steel PM pistol with brown grip; preserve its silhouette, furniture and colors, omit the reference background and label. NEW IMAGE, not an edit of reference layout. Create one transparent PNG 1536x1024, exactly 6 columns by 4 rows of equal 256x256 invisible cells, 24 discrete weapon poses. NO visible grid, borders, labels or numbers. Each cell contains this same complete weapon, barrel pointing RIGHT, side profile, no perspective. Gun must fit inside each cell with at least 20 pixels padding, muzzle flash also inside. Maintain fixed scale and shared grip pivot at local x=105 y=144 in ALL 24 cells; no independent recentring. Ready long-gun silhouette spans about x=35..205, pistol x=80..170. Crisp square pixel clusters like approved reference, 16-bit inventory/equipment sprite, muted steel, wood and olive, dark pixel outlines. True transparent background, no ground or shadow, no smoothing, no painted 3D.
ROW 1, left to right, is a single six-frame FIRE animation: 1 ready; 2 small sharp muzzle flash and initial recoil; 3 strongest recoil with a brief larger flash and a tiny spent-case glint only if appropriate; 4 flash gone, recoil recovery; 5 almost ready; 6 ready with tiny settling movement. Flash is always attached to the muzzle, no projectiles. 
ROWS 2,3,4, read row-major left to right, are ONE continuous 18-frame RELOAD animation. First pose ready, then smooth anticipation, clear middle reload action, then settling, final pose ready. Spread the action across all 18 unique poses with readable progression. An expressive game reload: gun tilts down slightly, old box magazine visibly lowers out of grip, empty magazine disappears, fresh magazine rises into grip, slide briefly changes position, weapon settles back to ready. Gun remains whole; avoid disassembly.
Only the weapon and small action-related magazine/cartridge shapes. NO hands, arms, people, scenery, disassembly, instructional arrows, diagrams, words or extra weapons. Every cell must have a complete main weapon silhouette. Mechanical action is stylized for game readability; retain model identity. Exactly 24 cells, never merge poses.
